name: How can I tell if my home needs a water pressure regulator in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my home needs a water pressure regulator in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your home may need a water pressure regulator include banging pipes, dripping faucets, continuously running toilets, or appliances like washing machines and dishwashers failing prematurely. In Las Vegas, high water pressure can be a particular issue due to the municipal supply lines. CG Plumbing Solutions can perform a pressure test to accurately diagnose if your home's water pressure is above the recommended safe levels, typically between 40-80 PSI.
